chief_complaint: Obesity with stage‑1 hypertension, worsened by recent unemployment and social isolation.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 51‑year‑old male with a long‑standing history of obesity diagnosed in 1990 and a remote traumatic brain injury in 1992. He remained relatively stable until August 2002 when he lost full‑time employment and became socially isolated. At his last recorded visit in August 2002 his blood pressure was 124/85 mmHg (stage‑1 hypertension) and heart rate 97 bpm. No antihypertensive or other chronic medications are documented. Healthcare utilization has been minimal (13 visits over 40 years) with no recent follow‑up, and key laboratory data (lipids, glucose, renal function) are missing.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include gingivitis (resolved 2002-08-17), acute bronchitis (resolved 2000-10-28), acute infective cystitis (resolved 1999-12-16), a prior episode of social isolation (resolved 2000-10-20), and full‑time employment (ended 2002-08-03).
social_determinants: Unemployment since 2002, ongoing social isolation, high school education only, likely limited income and health‑literacy, and minimal engagement with healthcare services.
risk_factor_summary: Cardiovascular risk: obesity, stage‑1 hypertension, tachycardia, no lipid or glucose data; metabolic risk: obesity with missing A1c and lipid panel; renal risk: hypertension with no eGFR; neurologic risk: remote brain injury; musculoskeletal risk: scoliosis compounded by obesity; psychosocial risk: unemployment, social isolation, low education. Overall clinical complexity is moderate with Charlson index 0.

data_quality_flags.issue: BMI numeric value missing; only obesity flag present.
Smoking, alcohol use, and physical activity information not documented.

clinical_impression: Middle-aged male with obesity and stage‑1 hypertension, compounded by psychosocial stressors (unemployment, social isolation) and a remote brain injury; limited data on metabolic and renal parameters, overall moderate clinical complexity.
